DesignSystem.dc.html.title: Design system — tokens, type, motion, components

tierb1.text:
TIER B / 1 — HERO BUILD MOMENT

Behaviour: on mount the blueprint assembles. Frame outline draws (stroke-dashoffset, 400ms). Header bar, hero text blocks, dashed image frame and three cards fade+rise 8px, staggered 60ms, in DOM order. Dimension lines and labels last.

Timing: 1.1s total, --ease-standard. Starts after first paint; the assembled state is the SSR markup, so the SVG is the LCP element either way.

Idle: cursor parallax. Pointer position maps to a ±6px translate on the dashed frame, ±3px on the card row, ±2px on the outline. Spring, damping 30, stiffness 120. Pointer-coarse devices get a 4s ambient drift instead.

States: initial (flat), assembling, idle, reduced-motion (renders assembled, no parallax, no drift).

tierb2.text:
TIER B / 2 — PINNED STACK STORY

Behaviour: the section pins for 6 x 100vh of scroll. Left column stays fixed; the six step rows advance with scroll progress. Active row: full-opacity text, purple index, 7% purple row tint. Inactive: 55% opacity. Progress rail fills 0→100% and the counter reads 01/06 → 06/06.

Timing: row transition 320ms, --ease-standard. Progress rail tracks scroll directly, no easing. Steps snap on cross, they don't crossfade.

Scroll-linked via useScroll + useTransform, no scroll hijacking — the user's scroll speed is the only input.

States: before pin, pinned 01..06, released. Reduced motion and <1024px: no pin, all six rows render stacked at full opacity, rail shows 06/06.

tierb3.text:
TIER B / 3 — PLATFORM SELECTOR

Behaviour: four options, one selected. Selection moves a shared layoutId pill behind the active button (220ms spring, damping 26). The panel morphs: stack name and reason crossfade out 120ms, new content fades in +8px over 200ms; the three spec lines stagger 50ms. Panel height animates to the new content height, never jumps.

Keyboard: arrow keys move between options (roving tabindex), Enter/Space selects, focus ring always visible. Touch: the option row scrolls horizontally, tap selects.

States: content site (default) / store / app / have-a-design. Selection persists in the URL hash so a recommendation can be linked.

Reduced motion: content swaps instantly, pill jumps, height is not animated.
